object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make a git repository with two committed documents, PARENT and CHILD, CHILD-1 linking to PARENT-1 with its acknowledged commit recorded. From a folder that isn't that repository's root, run mellon-check with --repo-root naming it; then set PARENT-1's status to a value that isn't an option and run it again. Expected: exit status 0 and 2 documents checked the first time; exit status 1 and a line naming PARENT and ATTR_BAD_ENUM the second time.
